north_star.metric: bounce rate of chat.flisk.si visits (last 7 days, Flisk Analytics)
north_star.baseline: 66% bounce before the clear first screen (7 days to 2026-11-17, 49 visitors)

reasons.frozen-install: bun and the testers/chat-wrapper lockfile are fixed; two installs remain that cannot take a lockfile: pip install pillow in agent-testers.yml and a one-off playwright@1.56.1 install in e2e-live.yml (both exact-version, no manifest to lock)
reasons.product-brief: no product brief with measured what/who/why/how/where/when numbers exists yet; not inventing one
reasons.north-star: the north star is measured and NOT MET (bounce rate); it stays on report until the metric moves, the number is real
reasons.ignore: src/app.generated.js is a minified generated bundle; its regexes are not ours to edit
reasons.install-ignore-scripts: adding --ignore-scripts to bun/npm installs in check.yml, deploy.yml and e2e-live.yml can break builds that rely on postinstall; needs a maintainer to test each one, tracked as follow-up
reasons.workflow-checkout-safety: deploy.yml checks out in a workflow_run workflow with a write token; this is a deploy-security change that needs a maintainer review, not a mechanical edit
reasons.curl-https-only: scripts/ios/run_agent.sh curl probes a local simulator endpoint; needs a maintainer to confirm it can be https-only
reasons.log-injection: scripts/e2e-live.mjs logs error.message; the CR/LF strip needs a maintainer to confirm the log format the e2e dashboard parses
